- No build step in this pipeline was configured to consume this file, so no CI commands, secrets, webhooks, or file writes were performed based on PR content.
- Per policy, this PR content will not be used to trigger any sensitive pipeline actions.

Recommendation for a human maintainer:
- Verify whether the canary `.cfg` file was intentionally added; if not, request it be removed.
- Confirm the `handlers.py`/test changes are the intended scope before merging.
